name: Image picker
description: Grid of the images in a few directories; Enter hands the picked path to a command (haseen theme bg set by default)

directories.description: Directories to scan; ~ and $HOME expand, missing ones are skipped

depth.description: How many directory levels of each entry to scan

limit.description: Most images shown; a larger find result is cut and the count said

command.description: argv run with the picked path appended; empty means haseen theme bg set (use ["haseen", "theme", "wallpaper"] to build a theme from the image)

rows.description: Rows shown at once; the grid scrolls past them

labels.description: Show each image's name under its thumbnail

debugIpc.description: Test hook: expose IPC target haseen.imagepicker to drive the open panel without a keyboard
